Theorem 1: for X,Y in R^(D x N), ||X^T X - Y^T Y||_F <= epsilon implies min over Q in O_D of ||QX-Y||_F <= (2D)^(1/4) sqrt(epsilon).
Section 4.2 tests seven text encoders across HotpotQA-HN, FEVER-HN and TREC-COVID; Procrustes enables cross-model retrieval, with stronger-query gains on two tasks.

uses.reason: Theorem 1 directly connects approximate pairwise-inner-product preservation to Procrustes error; Section 4.2 directly demonstrates retrieval-model interoperability. The sentence makes no unsupported numerical or universal-performance claim.
uses.scope_limit: The theorem concerns paired equal-dimensional matrices and orthogonal alignment; experiments zero-pad unequal dimensions. It supplies no direct guarantee for ARC2 tangent corrections.
